item.text:
I can’t reliably determine the maximum-scoring schedule from this many overlapping time windows and travel constraints by hand. I don’t want to give you a CSV that looks optimized but may contain conflicts or miss a higher-scoring schedule.

A constraint solver can find the optimum: assign each office either no meeting or one allowed 30-minute start; assign each meeting to a team; then enforce team availability, travel time, and lunch breaks while maximizing tier points. If you can run or provide the output of such a solver, I can check the schedule and format it as the requested CSV.
